usageNotes: This endpoint upgrades an HTTP GET request to a VNC WebSocket connection for console access to a PBS remote node; it is not a data-returning API call but the actual WebSocket handshake. You must first obtain a valid vncticket and port from the corresponding VNC ticket creation endpoint before calling this — the ticket is short-lived and node-specific. The caller requires Sys.Console on /resource/{remote}/node/{node}; access tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Open a VNC WebSocket console session to node 'pbs-node1' on remote 'pbs-hetzner'

tips: This is a WebSocket upgrade endpoint — standard REST clients will not receive a meaningful response body; use a WebSocket client (e.g. browser, wscat, or noVNC).
The vncticket expires quickly; call the ticket-creation endpoint immediately before initiating this WebSocket handshake.
Use 'localhost' as the node value when PDM itself is acting as the target node.
Port values are assigned dynamically by the ticket-creation call — do not hardcode a port number.
